Class TileDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.dto.TileDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TileDTO extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a single board tile as transferred between server and client.

Carries all the information needed to render the tile on the board: its identity, occupancy state, the player who placed a pawn on it, and the rewards it grants when occupied.

  • Constructor Details

    • TileDTO

      public TileDTO(boolean occupied, int id, int minPlayers, String player, int upDraws, int downDraws, int foodAmount)
      Creates a TileDTO with all attributes specified explicitly.
      Parameters:
      occupied - true if the tile is currently occupied
      id - unique tile identifier
      minPlayers - minimum number of players required for this tile
      player - nickname of the occupying player, or null
      upDraws - the upper row draws granted by this tile
      downDraws - the lower row draws granted by this tile
      foodAmount - food granted by this tile

    • TileDTO

      public TileDTO(TileDTO tileDTO, String player, boolean occupied)
      Copy constructor that overrides the occupancy state and the occupying player. All other attributes are copied from tileDTO.
      Parameters:
      tileDTO - the source tile
      player - nickname of the new occupying player, or null
      occupied - new occupancy state
